text:
Luca’s last move puts the brooch in the wicker basket. Nobody moves it after that.

ANSWER: C

Yara saw Farah in the study when Yara moved the brooch to the black trunk. Farah then left, and Yara didn’t know that Farah watched Luca’s later moves through the window. So Yara thinks Farah still believes the brooch is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: C

Yara is in the study and sees Luca move the brooch to the blue drawer and then to the wicker basket. The last move updates her belief.

ANSWER: A

Yara saw Tariq watch Oksana move the brooch to the blue drawer. She doesn’t know that Tariq watched through the window or received Luca’s text, and she has no reason to think he knows about the later moves. So Yara thinks Tariq still believes the brooch is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: D

Tariq hears Farah say the brooch is in the blue drawer, and Luca’s text tells him the same thing. Tariq does not see or hear about any of the later moves, so he still thinks it is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: D

Tariq hears Farah say the brooch is in the blue drawer, and Luca’s text confirms it. Tariq doesn’t see or hear about any of the later moves, so he opens the blue drawer first.

ANSWER: A

Farah saw Tariq watch Oksana move the brooch to the blue drawer. She doesn’t know he later listened through the window or received Luca’s private text. So Tariq thinks Farah would still expect him to believe the brooch is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: C

Yara waits beside the black trunk. Farah was still in the study when Yara put the brooch there, but she left before Luca moved it again. Yara doesn’t know Farah watched through the window, so she expects Farah to open the trunk first.

ANSWER: B

Amara last reassigned the Marlow account to the Nairobi office in step 7. The later messages did not change the assignment.

ANSWER: C

Mirela hears that the account is with Denver in step 6, and Pablo confirms it in a direct message in step 8. She never learns about the later reassignment to Nairobi.

ANSWER: D

Amara last reassigned the Marlow account to Nairobi in step 7. She did not receive either of the later private messages, so her belief did not change.

ANSWER: D

Mirela hears that the account is with the Denver office in step 6, and Pablo confirms it in his message to her. She never learns that it was later reassigned to Nairobi, so she honestly says it is with the Denver office.

ANSWER: C

Quinn heard Pablo read out that the account was with the Denver office. Quinn knows Pablo wasn’t on the later call when it moved to Nairobi, and Quinn doesn’t know about Luca’s private message to Pablo. So Quinn thinks Pablo still believes the account is with Denver.

ANSWER: D

Luca knows the brooch is in the wicker basket. Oksana and Yara saw Luca put it there. As far as Luca knows, Tariq still thinks it is in the blue drawer because of the text, and Farah still thinks it is in the black trunk because she left before the final moves. Luca does not know Farah watched through the window.

ANSWER: Tariq, Farah

Quinn expects Pablo to say **the Denver office**. Quinn heard Pablo read out Denver in step 6. Quinn knows the account was later moved to Nairobi, but doesn’t know that Luca heard the change and privately told Pablo. Pablo will actually say Nairobi, but Quinn writes down Denver.

ANSWER: B

Pablo knows Mirela read his message saying the account was with Denver. Luca’s later message updates Pablo’s own belief to Nairobi, but Pablo has no reason to think Mirela received that update. So he still thinks she believes the account is with Denver.

ANSWER: A

Oksana knows Luca was out of the study when Tariq saw the brooch moved to the blue drawer. Luca later heard that the brooch was in the drawer, but that announcement didn’t tell him what Tariq knew. Oksana doesn’t know about Luca’s private text to Tariq, so she thinks Luca still believes Tariq remembers the brooch being in the black trunk.

ANSWER: B

Pablo tells Mirela in a private message that the account is with Denver. Mirela knows Pablo knows she read it, so she thinks he believes she thinks the account is with Denver. Luca’s later message to Pablo is private, so it doesn’t change Mirela’s view.

ANSWER: D

Tariq put the whistle in the copper tin, and nobody moved it afterward.

ANSWER: C

Amara last saw the marble in the black trunk, but Yara’s private text told her it was in the white cabinet. Amara believed the text and received no newer information about the marble.

ANSWER: D

Farah watches Luca move the brooch to the wicker basket. She knows Yara and Oksana both see the move and can see each other in the study. So Farah thinks Yara knows that Oksana saw Yara witness the move. The earlier messages and the missed announcement don’t change what they see at the end.

ANSWER: B

Farah believes Tariq left without knowing about either private text to Luca. From what Farah thinks Tariq witnessed, the last location Luca knew was the black trunk: Luca saw the brooch put there but left before it was moved to the blue drawer.

Farah doesn’t know Tariq overheard her later announcement, so she thinks Tariq still believes that she takes Luca to think the brooch is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: D

Mirela believes the account is with Denver. She heard Pablo read out Denver on the call with Quinn and Amara, so as far as she knows, all three share her view. The last assignment she knows Luca heard was Nairobi.

ANSWER: Luca

Luca believes Mirela heard Pablo reassign the account to Lisbon on call 2. On call 3, Mirela heard the account move back to Nairobi, but from Luca’s perspective, she had no reason to think Pablo heard that change.

Luca’s final message tells Pablo the account is in Nairobi, but it’s private. Luca therefore still thinks Mirela believes Pablo thinks the account is in Lisbon.

ANSWER: A

Yara missed Tariq putting the whistle away, but she hears Amara say it’s in the copper tin and believes her.

ANSWER: C

Amara last saw the marble go into the black trunk, but Yara’s later text tells her it is in the white cabinet. Amara believes the text, so she opens the white cabinet first.

ANSWER: B

When Pablo tells Mirela “Denver” in step 8, he knows she reads the message. He also expects Mirela to understand that he knows she read it. So Pablo thinks that Mirela thinks that Pablo thinks that Mirela believes the account is in Denver.

Luca’s private message in step 9 changes Pablo’s own belief to Nairobi, but it doesn’t change what he thinks Mirela believes about his knowledge.

ANSWER: D

Luca watched Tariq put the whistle in the copper tin. He saw that Yara was in the workshop and didn’t realize she missed it, so he thinks she believes the whistle is in the copper tin.

ANSWER: D

Yara saw Jonas move the marble to the black trunk. She later learned from Tariq’s private text that it was in the white cabinet, but she didn’t know Jonas had seen that move or that he watched her move it to the green cupboard. So she still thinks Jonas believes it’s in the black trunk.

ANSWER: D

Yara waits beside the black trunk. That’s the last place she knows Jonas saw the marble being put. She doesn’t know that he watched her move it to the green cupboard, so she expects him to open the trunk first.

ANSWER: A

Amara believes the last update Pablo heard with both Quinn and Luca present was the reassignment to Lisbon in step 2. She doesn’t know Pablo secretly heard the Nairobi update in step 3. The Denver readout in step 6 didn’t include Luca, and Amara doesn’t know about Luca’s later message to Pablo. So in Amara’s view, Pablo still thinks Quinn believes Luca thinks the account is in Lisbon.

ANSWER: B

Jonas saw Luca put the marble in the white cabinet and knows Tariq saw it too. Tariq saw Yara move it later, but has no reason to think Luca saw that move. So Jonas thinks Tariq believes Luca still thinks the marble is in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: C

In step 9, Ines reassigns the Marlow account to Osaka. No later change occurs.

ANSWER: B

Amara knows Tariq already believes the whistle is in the copper tin because he told her. Yara and Jonas hear her announcement. Luca is outside, and Amara doesn’t know he saw Tariq put the whistle there, so she sends a note only to Luca.

ANSWER: Luca

Wanjiru last learned that the Marlow account was assigned to Nairobi when she reassigned it herself in step 4. She wasn't on the call where Ines later reassigned it to Osaka, and no one told her about that change.

ANSWER: D

Wanjiru last assigned the Marlow account to Nairobi. She wasn’t on the final call and never learned that Ines reassigned it to Osaka, so she says “the Nairobi office.”

ANSWER: C

Ines was on the call when Xavier set the offsite location to Porto. Nothing afterward changed her belief about the offsite; the final call concerned only the Marlow account.

ANSWER: D

Luca sees Tariq put the whistle in the copper tin while Amara is away. He doesn’t know about Tariq’s private text to Amara, and he’s outside when Amara announces the whistle’s location. So Luca thinks Amara has no idea where it is.

ANSWER: E

Luca knows that Jonas saw Yara watch the marble being moved to the black trunk. Yara was out of the workshop when Luca moved it to the white cabinet. Luca doesn’t know that Jonas later saw Yara move the marble to the green cupboard, so Luca thinks Jonas still believes Yara thinks it’s in the black trunk.

ANSWER: A

Amara says aloud that the whistle is in the copper tin. She sees that Jonas and Tariq are both present, so she thinks Jonas knows Tariq heard her. Since people say what they believe unless they intend to mislead, Amara thinks Jonas takes Tariq to believe that she thinks the whistle is in the copper tin.

ANSWER: C

Keiko heard the original Denver assignment on a call with Wanjiru. She didn’t hear any of the intervening reassignments, and Wanjiru wasn’t on the final call when Ines assigned the account to Osaka. So Keiko thinks Wanjiru still believes the account is in Denver.

ANSWER: D

Keiko writes **the Denver office**. She saw Wanjiru hear the original Denver assignment, but she missed the later calls where Wanjiru changed it. Keiko knows about the final Osaka assignment, but Wanjiru wasn’t on that call.

ANSWER: C

Jonas moved the marble to the black trunk while everyone was watching. Luca later moved it to the white cabinet after Yara left. Jonas and Tariq saw that move, but both knew Yara had missed it.

Luca doesn’t know about Tariq’s private text to Yara or Jonas’s secret observation through the window. So, from Luca’s perspective, Jonas still thinks Tariq believes Yara’s last known location for the marble is the black trunk.

ANSWER: D

Xavier heard Wanjiru reassign the Marlow account to Nairobi in step 4. He doesn’t know about the later reassignment to Osaka, so he thinks Wanjiru still believes the account is in Nairobi.

ANSWER: C

Ines tells Hana in a direct message that the offsite is in Porto. Hana knows that Ines knows she read the message, so Hana thinks Ines believes Hana thinks the offsite is in Porto.

ANSWER: C

Ines’s final move put the medal in the black trunk. The later text messages did not move it.

ANSWER: D

Xavier and Wanjiru both heard the account reassigned to Nairobi on call 4, and each could see that the other was present. That shared information supports every level of the belief in the question. Neither learned about the later reassignment to Osaka.

ANSWER: B

Quinn’s text is the latest information Oksana receives. She believes the medal is in the white cabinet, so she opens it first.

ANSWER: D

Xavier believes the account is in Nairobi, and he knows Wanjiru heard that reassignment. As far as he knows, Ines and Hana still believe it’s in Osaka, and Keiko still believes it’s in Denver. He doesn’t know about the final call.

ANSWER: Ines, Hana, Keiko

Oksana saw Soren move the medal to the blue drawer before she left. Later, Quinn privately told her it was in the white cabinet. That was the last update Oksana received, so she believes the medal is in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: A

Ines moved the medal to the black trunk and received no later information that changed her belief.

ANSWER: B

Hana hears Xavier choose Porto on the call Keiko isn’t on, and Ines later tells Hana privately. Hana doesn’t hear Xavier tell Keiko on the separate call, so she thinks Keiko doesn’t know where the offsite is.

ANSWER: E

Ines and Keiko both heard the original Denver assignment. Keiko missed the later account changes until the final call, when Ines reassigned the account to Osaka. Ines knows that Keiko saw Wanjiru was absent from that call. So although Keiko now knows the account is in Osaka, Ines thinks Keiko still believes that Wanjiru thinks Ines believes it is in Denver.

ANSWER: A

Keiko heard Ines assign the account to Denver on the first call, and she saw that Hana heard it too. Keiko missed the later calls that changed the assignment, and Hana wasn’t on the final call. So although Keiko knows the account is now assigned to Osaka, she thinks Ines still believes Hana’s last information was Denver.

ANSWER: C

Ines texts Quinn that the medal is in the black trunk. Quinn believes her, and Quinn knows that Ines knows he read the message. So Quinn thinks Ines believes he thinks the medal is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: A

Dalia’s reassignment in step 12 puts the Marlow account with the Osaka office. Yara missing the announcement doesn’t change the assignment.

ANSWER: D

Ines told Keiko that the medal was in the blue drawer and knows Keiko read her message. Keiko later learned that it was in the black trunk by secretly reading other messages, but Ines doesn’t know that. So Ines still thinks Keiko believes the medal is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: A

Keiko secretly reads Quinn’s text telling Soren that the medal is in the black trunk. She knows Soren reads the text at once and believes it, so she thinks he believes the medal is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: A

Jonas tells Yara that the Marlow account is with the Lisbon office. Yara misses the final reassignment to Osaka, so she still thinks it is with Lisbon.

ANSWER: D

Ines waits beside the blue drawer. She told Keiko the medal was there and doesn’t know that Keiko secretly read the later messages naming the black trunk. Keiko will actually open the black trunk, but Ines expects her to open the blue drawer.

ANSWER: B

Jonas hears Dalia reassign the Marlow account to the Osaka office on the final call. Yara misses the change, but Jonas does not.

ANSWER: B

Jonas tells Yara that the Marlow account is with the Lisbon office. Yara misses the final reassignment to Osaka, so she honestly says it’s with the Lisbon office.

ANSWER: B

Oksana secretly hears Dalia reassign the Marlow account to Osaka on the final call. Since Dalia makes the reassignment herself, Oksana thinks Dalia knows the account is with Osaka.

ANSWER: B

Keiko secretly reads Quinn’s text telling Soren that the medal is in the black trunk. Quinn knows Soren reads it, and Soren takes Quinn to believe what he says. So Keiko thinks Quinn thinks Soren takes Quinn’s belief to be **the black trunk**.

ANSWER: A

Dalia told Oksana in a private message that the Marlow account was with the Denver office. Dalia doesn’t know about Jonas’s later message to Oksana or that Oksana secretly listened to later calls. So Dalia thinks Oksana still believes the account is with Denver.

ANSWER: D

Soren saw that Oksana was present when Keiko watched Ines put the medal in the white cabinet and then left. He doesn’t know that Keiko watched through the window or that Oksana later texted her. So Soren thinks Oksana still believes Keiko’s last information was that the medal was in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: B

Soren saw Ines move the medal to the black trunk, so he knows Ines shares his view. Quinn texted Soren that the medal was in the black trunk, so Soren knows Quinn shares it too.

As far as Soren knows, Oksana still thinks the medal is in the blue drawer, and Keiko still thinks it is in the white cabinet. He doesn’t know about the private messages they received or the messages Keiko secretly read.

ANSWER: Oksana, Keiko

Dalia expects Oksana to say Denver. That’s what Dalia told her, and Dalia doesn’t know about Jonas’s private message or Oksana’s secret listening.

ANSWER: C

Dalia reassigns the account to Osaka on the final call. Jonas hears the change and knows Dalia can see he’s on the call, so he thinks Dalia believes he knows the account is with Osaka.

ANSWER: A

Ines last moved the brooch to the green cupboard. Amara’s later text was misleading and did not change its location.

ANSWER: B

The last location Ines knows that she, Keiko, and Quinn all saw was the white cabinet. Ines’s text tells Keiko that the medal is now in the blue drawer, but it doesn’t tell her what Quinn knows. Ines also doesn’t know that Keiko watched through the window or read the later texts.

So from Ines’s perspective, Keiko still thinks that Ines takes Quinn’s belief to be **the white cabinet**.

ANSWER: D

Keiko saw the brooch move to the wicker basket but missed both later moves. She believes Amara’s text saying it is in the grey locker.

ANSWER: D

Keiko sees through the window that the compass is in the round tin. Both Ines and Amara confirm that location by text, and the compass is never moved.

ANSWER: B

Dalia believes the account is with Osaka. She thinks Rania, Yara, and Jonas all heard the final reassignment, because she doesn’t know Yara missed it. As far as Dalia knows, Oksana still believes the account is with Denver, which is what Dalia told her directly.

ANSWER: Oksana

Keiko is outside when Ines moves the brooch to the green cupboard. She believes Amara’s private text saying it’s in the grey locker, so she opens that first.

ANSWER: B

Amara told Keiko that the brooch was in the grey locker after Ines moved it to the green cupboard. Amara knows Keiko read the message, so she thinks Keiko believes the brooch is in the grey locker.

ANSWER: D

On call 2, Yara saw Rania reassign Marlow to Lisbon while Oksana was present. That was the last update Yara knew both Rania and Oksana had heard. Yara didn’t know about the private messages to Oksana or Oksana’s secret listening, and Jonas’s message to Yara didn’t tell her what Oksana knew. So Yara thinks Rania still believes Oksana thinks the account is in Lisbon.

ANSWER: C

Ines saw Keiko leave while the brooch was still in the wicker basket. Ines doesn’t know about Amara’s private text to Keiko, so she thinks Keiko still believes the brooch is in the basket.

ANSWER: D

Ines waits beside the wicker basket. That’s where Keiko last saw the brooch, and Ines doesn’t know about Amara’s private text telling Keiko it’s in the grey locker.

ANSWER: A

Keiko moved the client workshop to Room Alder in step 5, and no one changed the workshop booking after that. The later moves were for the team offsite.

ANSWER: B

Keiko reads Amara’s private text saying the brooch is in the grey locker. Since Amara knows Keiko reads it immediately, Keiko thinks Amara expects her to believe the brooch is there.

ANSWER: D

Uma moves the workshop to Room Dogwood in step 3. She never learns that Keiko later moves it to Room Alder. Farah’s message to Uma is about the offsite, not the workshop.

ANSWER: B

Keiko saw Quinn move the brooch to the wicker basket before she left, and Quinn knows Amara saw Keiko there. Quinn doesn’t know about Amara’s private text saying the brooch is in the grey locker. So Quinn thinks Amara still believes Keiko thinks the brooch is in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: B

Quinn saw the compass in the round tin, but Keiko was outside. Quinn didn’t know she watched through the window or received private texts about the compass. The only text Quinn secretly read was about the brooch. So Quinn thinks Keiko doesn’t know where the compass is.

ANSWER: E

From Dalia’s perspective, Oksana saw Rania move the account to Lisbon while Jonas was absent. Dalia later told Oksana that the account was in Denver, but that message didn’t tell Oksana anything about what Rania thought Jonas knew. Dalia doesn’t know about the secret listening or the other private messages.

So Dalia thinks Oksana still takes Rania to believe that Jonas knows only about the original Osaka assignment.

ANSWER: A

Uma last learned the workshop’s location when she moved it to Room Dogwood. She was never told it was later moved to Room Alder, so she says “Room Dogwood.”

ANSWER: D

Keiko moved the workshop to Room Alder and later confirmed it by reading the booking system aloud. Nothing afterward changed the workshop booking or her belief about it.

ANSWER: A

Quinn knows the compass is in the round tin. Amara and Ines saw it when Quinn opened the tins, and Emeka heard Amara announce its location after he returned. Quinn doesn’t know that Keiko watched through the window or received private texts about the compass, so Keiko is the only person Quinn sends a note to.

ANSWER: Keiko

From Rania’s perspective, the last time Oksana saw Rania and Dalia learn the assignment together was the Lisbon reassignment in step 2. The later messages don’t tell Oksana what Rania thinks Dalia knows, and Rania doesn’t know that Oksana listened in on later calls. So the nested belief still points to Lisbon.

ANSWER: D

Yara heard Uma move the workshop to Room Dogwood on call 3. Yara later heard that it was booked in Room Alder, but Uma wasn’t on that call, and nothing tells Yara that Uma learned about the change. So Yara thinks Uma still believes the workshop is in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: D

Amara’s private text tells Keiko that the brooch is in the grey locker. Keiko believes the message and takes Amara to know she read it. Amara therefore thinks that Keiko thinks Amara expects Keiko to believe the brooch is in the grey locker, even though it is actually in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: B

Farah knows the workshop is booked in Room Alder because Goran told her. But she doesn’t know that Keiko moved it there or read out the updated booking. The last room Farah knows Keiko heard about is Room Dogwood, so that’s what she expects Keiko to say.

ANSWER: D

Farah secretly heard Uma move the workshop to Room Dogwood and saw that Keiko was on the call. Goran later told Farah that the workshop was in Room Alder, but he didn’t tell her that Keiko knew. So Farah still thinks Keiko believes it’s in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: B

On call 6, Yara and Goran both hear Keiko read out Room Alder, and each can see that the other is on the call. So Yara thinks Goran knows that she heard the booking was in Room Alder. Nothing later changes that belief.

ANSWER: B

On the final call, Farah moves the offsite to Ghent. Yara, Goran, and Farah all hear the change and can see that the others are present. So Yara thinks that Goran thinks that Farah thinks Yara heard the update and believes the offsite is in Ghent.

ANSWER: C

Goran’s final move puts the harmonica in the red box. The text messages do not change its actual location.

ANSWER: D

Yara hears the final move to Ghent, but Uma isn’t on that call. Yara doesn’t know about Farah’s private message to Uma, so she thinks Uma has no idea where the offsite is.

ANSWER: E

Hana is outside the cellar when the final move happens, so she doesn’t see it. The latest information she receives is Bruno’s text saying the harmonica is in the wooden chest. She believes him and opens that chest first.

ANSWER: C

Farah secretly hears the workshop move to Room Dogwood and sees that both Goran and Yara are on the call. She therefore thinks Goran knows that Yara heard the change.

Goran later tells Farah that the workshop is booked in Room Alder, but he doesn’t tell her that Yara heard the new booking too. So Farah still thinks Goran thinks Yara believes it’s in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: A

Hana first believes Goran’s text that the harmonica is in the red box. Bruno’s later text replaces that belief: she now thinks it’s in the wooden chest. Hana is outside the cellar and doesn’t see Goran’s final move.

ANSWER: B

Farah believes the workshop is in Room Alder because Goran told her, so she knows Goran shares her view. She secretly heard the move to Dogwood and saw that Yara, Uma, and Keiko were on that call. She doesn’t know that Keiko later moved the booking back to Alder or read it out to Yara. As far as Farah can tell, all three still believe it’s in Dogwood.

ANSWER: Yara, Uma, Keiko

Bruno is still in the cellar when Goran moves the harmonica to the red box. He sees the move, so he believes it is in the red box.

ANSWER: B

Hana told Chidi by private text that the harmonica was in the wicker basket, and she knows he read it. She doesn’t know that Chidi secretly read Bruno’s later message, so she still thinks Chidi believes it’s in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: C

Hana told Chidi the harmonica was in the wicker basket. She doesn’t know he secretly read Bruno’s later message saying it was in the wooden chest, so she expects him to open the wicker basket first and waits beside it.

ANSWER: B

Goran knows Hana read his text saying the harmonica was in the red box. He doesn’t know about Bruno’s later private text, so he still thinks Hana believes it’s in the red box.

ANSWER: D

Goran thinks Farah last heard him and Yara learn the workshop location together when he moved it to Room Fir. He doesn’t know Farah secretly heard the move to Dogwood, and she wasn’t on the call when Keiko read out Room Alder. His later message told Farah the room was Alder, but it didn’t tell her that Yara knew. So Goran thinks Farah still thinks he believes Yara’s answer is Room Fir.

ANSWER: A

Amara and Quinn both saw Emeka leave before Quinn moved the brooch out of the canvas sack. They also saw that Keiko was still there, so they would expect Keiko to think Emeka’s last known location for the brooch was the canvas sack.

Keiko’s private text to Emeka changed what Keiko thought Emeka knew, and Quinn secretly read it. But Amara didn’t know about the text or Quinn’s secret reading, so in Amara’s view, Quinn’s belief about what Keiko thought never changed.

ANSWER: C

Zoltan hears the workshop move to Room Elm on call 12, but he is not on call 13 when it moves to Room Fir. He then receives and believes two messages saying it is in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: D

The last actual booking change is in step 13, when Oksana moves the workshop to Room Fir. The later messages claim it is in Room Dogwood, but they do not change the booking.

ANSWER: B

Goran texts Hana that the harmonica is in the red box, and Hana knows he expects her to believe him. Bruno’s later text changes Hana’s own belief, but Goran doesn’t know about it. So Hana thinks Goran still believes she thinks it’s in the red box.

ANSWER: A

Zoltan hears the move to Room Elm in step 12 but misses the move to Room Fir in step 13. He believes the later messages from Oksana and Xavier saying the workshop is in Room Dogwood, so that is what he tells the client.

ANSWER: A

Xavier hears Oksana move the workshop to Room Fir on the final call. He doesn’t see Oksana’s private message to Zoltan, and his own message saying Dogwood is meant to mislead Zoltan, so it doesn’t change his belief.

ANSWER: B

Jonas expects Goran to say **Room Cedar**. Jonas told Goran the workshop was in Cedar and doesn’t know that Goran received any later updates. Goran actually knows it’s in Room Fir, but Jonas wasn’t on that call.

ANSWER: C

The last time Hana saw Chidi and Goran together, Bruno showed everyone that the harmonica was in the grey locker. Hana didn’t know Goran missed the reveal, so she believed Chidi saw Goran learn that it was there.

Hana’s text to Chidi gave him a new location, but it didn’t tell him what Goran believed. Hana therefore still thinks Chidi thinks Goran believes it’s in the grey locker.

ANSWER: D

Oksana saw Jonas on the call in step 9 when Zoltan moved the workshop to Room Fir. Jonas wasn’t on any later calls, and Oksana has no reason to think he learned about any later change.

ANSWER: C

Jonas told Goran that the workshop was booked in Room Cedar and knows Goran read the message. Jonas never learns that Goran receives any later updates, so he still thinks Goran believes it’s in Room Cedar.

ANSWER: C

Before Wanjiru and Chidi leave, they both see Bruno reveal the harmonica in the grey locker. Wanjiru thinks Chidi takes that reveal to be something Goran also saw, and that Goran therefore thinks Wanjiru believes the harmonica is in the grey locker. Wanjiru learns nothing later that changes this nested belief.

ANSWER: B

Oksana last moves the torch from the red box to the black trunk. After that, only the magnet is moved.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan was on the call when Xavier moved the workshop to Room Elm, but not on the later call when Oksana moved it to Room Fir. Oksana’s private message then told Zoltan it was in Room Dogwood, but Xavier didn’t see that message.

Finally, Xavier himself told Zoltan it was in Room Dogwood. Zoltan knows Xavier knows he read the message, so Zoltan thinks Xavier believes that Zoltan now thinks the workshop is in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: D

Goran sees Soren move the torch to the blue drawer. He leaves before it is moved again, and the later texts he receives are about the magnet, not the torch.

ANSWER: B

Goran saw Soren move the torch to the blue drawer. He left before Oksana moved it and never received another update about the torch, so he opens the blue drawer first.

ANSWER: B

Xavier knows that Goran and Jonas both heard the original booking in Room Dogwood. Xavier doesn’t know that Goran secretly heard Jonas move it to Room Cedar or that Jonas later messaged Goran.
